source: Mapzen / Tilezen public Terrarium elevation tiles
format: uint16-le, quarter meters, row-major; row 0 is world zMin
attribution: Mapzen / Tilezen; underlying SRTM and open elevation contributors. https://github.com/tilezen/joerd/blob/master/docs/attribution.md
note: The distant massif uses real sampled elevation without vertical exaggeration. The foreground ski line and village are designed, not a navigable real piste. DEM sampling smooths the true summit.
rendererUpdate: Flow Update 02: original DEM samples retained; summit restored locally to 4478 m in the renderer (145 m Gaussian), plus heightfield-derived ridge cast shading. Foreground remains a designed course.
